  - "The Intersectionality Wars" by Kimberlé Crenshaw (2016)
  - "Sister Outsider: Essays and Speeches" by Audre Lorde (1984)
  - "Home Girls: A Black Feminist Anthology" edited by Barbara Smith (1983)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Class and economy books recommended include:
  - "Women, Race, and Class" by Angela Y. Davis (1981)
  - "The Feminist Wire: Politics, Activism, and Scholarship" edited by Hortense J. Spillers, Darnell L. Moore, and Tamura A. Lomax (2017)
  - "Undivided Rights: Women of Color Organizing for Reproductive Justice" edited by Jael Silliman, Marlene Gerber Fried, Loretta Ross, and Elena R. Gutiérrez (2004)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ability and disability books recommended include:
  - "Feminist, Queer, Crip" by Alison Kafer (2013)
  - "Care Work: Dreaming Disability Justice" by Leah Lakshmi Piepzna-Samarasinha (2018)
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other influential works recommended include:
  - "The Gender of Racism: Antiracism, Feminism, and Critical Race Theory" by Paula Giddings (1995)
  - "Queer Phenomenology: Orientations, Objects, Others" by Sara Ahmed (2006)
  - "Bad Feminist" by Roxane Gay (2014)
